correctness.rationale: For arbitrary m,n>=1, prove the exact Hamiltonian-path weight max(a+b-1,2max(a,b)-2) by alternating the two parts; infer literal L_(2s+1)=K_s(A)*K_s(B), L_(2s)=sk_(2s) of that join. Skeleta of simplices are wedges, top integral boundary has rank binom(m,s+1)binom(n,s+1)-binom(m-1,s+1)binom(n-1,s+1); connectivity and integral Hurewicz/Whitehead promote even-stage homology to wedges (special s=0 handled). Adjacent homological degrees differ, so all reduced inclusion maps vanish; terminal scale 2min(m,n)-1 checked. Independently enumerated 187 exact Hamiltonian subset paths for part sizes <=3, matching weight (not extrapolated as infinite proof).
